english:
On Monday of the Resurrection. During this season of Pentecost: in the morning and in the evening say "Save us" (Këtso); do not say the "Creator of All" (Ararchakan) song, but say "Newly Created" (Norasteghtsyaln) on Sunday.
Midday Psalm 4 [4/5]: "Answer me when I call", "Give ear to my words", "O Lord, rebuke me not in thy anger".
Acts 2:22: "Men of Israel" to verse 41: "about three thousand souls".
Alleluia Psalm 147: "Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem".
Gospel Luke 24:1 to verse 12: "what had happened".

In the Evening:
First Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to thee".
Gospel Mark 16:2 to verse 8: "for they were afraid".
Messedi [Gradual]: "Thy throne, O God", "My heart overflows".
Hambartsi [Dismissal Hymn] Tone 2 [ak]: "Thou wast sent from the Father".
Dismissal Psalm 147: "Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem".
Gospel Luke 24:1 to verse 12: "what had happened".

Tuesday. Resurrection Tone 3 [bj]: "To Thy tomb".
Patristic [Harts] Tone 1 [ah]: "Shine forth".
Morning Psalm 5: "O Lord, as with a shield", alternative, "Give ear to my words", say the whole.
Gospel Luke 24:13: "And behold, two of them" to verse 35: "in the breaking of the bread".
Midday Psalm 7: "O Lord my God", "O Lord, our Lord", "I will give thanks".
Acts 2:42: "And they devoted themselves" to chapter 3:21: "of the prophets".
Alleluia Psalm 20 [21]: "The king trusts in the Lord", say the whole.
Gospel Luke 24:13: "And behold, two of them" to verse 35: "in the breaking of the bread".

In the Evening:
First Psalm 5: "O Lord, as with a shield".
Gospel Luke 24:1 to verse 12: "what had happened".
Messedi [Gradual]: "The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice", "The lightnings lit up".
Hambartsi [Dismissal Hymn] Tone 3 [bz]: "To Thy tomb".
Dismissal Psalm 20 [21]: "The king trusts in the Lord", say the whole.
Gospel Luke 24:13: "And behold, two of them" to verse 35: "in the breaking of the bread".

Wednesday. Resurrection Tone 4 [bk]: "To Thy resurrection".
Patristic [Harts] Tone 5 [ah-dz]: "Blessed art Thou, Lord God".
Psalm 147: "Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem".
Gospel Luke 24:36: "As they were saying this" to verse 40: "his hands and his feet".
Midday Psalm 10 [11]: "In the Lord I take refuge", "Help, Lord", "How long, O Lord?".
Acts 3:22: "Moses said to the fathers" to chapter 4:12: "by which we must be saved".
At this point, begin to read the Catholic Epistles.
Catholic [Epistle] James 1:1: "James, a servant of God" to verse 12: "to those who love him".
Alleluia: "Praise is due to thee".
Gospel Luke 24:36: "As they were saying this" to verse 40: "his hands and his feet".

In the Evening:
First Psalm 147: "Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem".
Gospel Luke 24:13: "And behold, two of them" to verse 35: "in the breaking of the bread".
Messedi [Gradual]: "Sing to the Lord", "Enter into".
Hambartsi [Dismissal Hymn] Tone 4 [bk]: "To Thy resurrection".
Dismissal Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to thee, O God".
Gospel Luke 24:36: "As they were saying" to verse 40: "his hands and his feet".

Thursday. Resurrection Tone 5 [g-dz]: "The oil-bearing women and the holy".
Patristic [Harts] Tone 1 [ah-dz]: "With the three children".
Morning Psalm 98 [99]: "Extol the Lord", alternative, "The Lord reigns".
Gospel Matthew 5:1: "Seeing the crowds" to verse 12: "who were before you".
Midday Psalm 13 [14]: "The fool says", "O Lord, who shall sojourn", "Preserve me, O God".
Acts 4:13: "Now when they saw the boldness" to verse 31: "with boldness".
Psalm 98 [99]: "Extol the Lord".
Catholic [Epistle] James 1:13: "Let no one say when he is tempted" to verse 27: "to keep oneself unstained from the world".
Alleluia: "O Lord, who shall sojourn".
Gospel Matthew 5:1: "And seeing the crowds" to verse 12: "who were before you".

In the Evening:
First Psalm: "Extol the Lord", alternative, "The Lord reigns".
Gospel Luke 24:36: "As they were saying this" to verse 40: "his hands and his feet".
Messedi [Gradual]: "Come and see", "God is our refuge".
Hambartsi [Dismissal Hymn] Tone 5 [g-dz]: "The oil-bearing women".
Dismissal Psalm 14 [15]: "O Lord, who shall sojourn".
Gospel Matthew 5:1: "And seeing the crowds" to verse 12: "who were before you".

Friday. Resurrection Tone 6 [gk]: "The Lord is risen".
Patristic [Harts] Tone 5 [od]: "Thou who art light from the fiery".
Morning Psalm 97 [98]: "All the ends of the earth have seen", alternative, "O sing to the Lord".
Gospel John 21:1: "After this" to verse 14: "after he was raised from the dead".
Midday Psalm 16 [17]: "Hear a just cause, O Lord", "I love thee, O Lord, my strength", "The heavens declare".
Acts 4:32: "Now the full number" to chapter 5:11: "and upon all who heard of these things".
Psalm 97 [98]: "All the ends of the earth have seen".
